ruleDefinitions.name: PrintBrm ZIP Creation of Extraction
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the execution of the LOLBIN PrintBrm.exe, which can be used to create or extract ZIP files. PrintBrm.exe should not be run on a normal workstation.

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\\\PrintBrm\\\.exe$") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-f.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.zip.*")))
